name: Emeka
self_text: I am a Chilean in my late 20s who spends a lot of free time collecting vinyl. On the console side of things, I play Skyforge Arena. For me, a typical session involves jumping into ranked matches, and I am happy to coach. I exclusively use text chat for communication during these games. I am available on Sunday mornings to play.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into Skyforge Arena and available Sunday morning. I'd strongly prefer that you are into casual matches, though it's not a requirement, and it would matter a lot if you are the one who gets coached by me, but I won't rule you out over it. It's a small bonus if we overlap on text chat.
